definitions.explanation: The forty-seven masterless samurai of the Akō domain who, in the winter of 1702–03, avenged their lord Asano Naganori by killing Kira Yoshinaka, and were then ordered to commit seppuku. Their story is told in the many versions of {忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら}.

notes:
Also called the {赤穂|あこう}{四十七士|しじゅうしちし} (the Forty-Seven Samurai of Akō).

- {討|う}ち{入|い}り: the raid on Kira's mansion

CULTURAL NOTE:
The raid took place on the 14th day of the 12th month by the old calendar, so December 14 is still marked by a festival at {泉岳寺|せんがくじ} in Tokyo, where they are buried.
